Session-end capture succeeded (exit 0).

## Summary

I implemented Claudinite work item #1755: moved the four task-related design docs (`tasks-dispatch/`, `task-preconditions/`, `task-code-work/`, `per-project-scheduling/`) from repo-level `docs/` into `packs/claudinite-tasks/docs/`, and carved a **generic** exclusion for every pack's own `docs/` directory out of the vendor set in `compute-vendor-set.mjs` (alongside the existing `test/`/`updates/` treatment) — `packs/claudinite-dashboard/docs/` benefits from the same rule, matching how its own comments already cite paths by `§` rather than by mount-resolvable reference.

Swept every reference the issue named (settings waivers, README, two tests), fixed relative-link depth inside the moved docs, extended the `packs → docs` barrier to also cover `packs/claudinite-tasks/docs`, and fixed two check regressions the move exposed (`runnable-doc-commands`, and the queue's vocabulary test) by extending their existing "maintainer reference, never vendored/never rewritten" exclusions to the moved docs.

Verified: `check_the_world` and `check_the_work --changed` both clean (0 blocking), full suite 3356/3357 green (the one failure is a pre-existing shallow-clone-only guard, unrelated to this diff).

Opened [PR #1813](https://github.com/missingbulb/Claudinite/pull/1813) against `main`. Its required CI check was still running when I tried to arm auto-merge (rejected as "unstable," not failing), so I subscribed this session to the PR's activity and parked issue #1755 as `task:status:needs-human-approval` pointing at it — the janitor will close the item automatically once the PR merges or is closed.

{"number":1813,"title":"Move task design docs into packs/claudinite-tasks/docs/, carved out of the vendor set","body":"Closes #1755

## The move

`git mv`d the four task-related design-doc directories whole into the pack that owns their subject:

- `docs/tasks-dispatch/` → `packs/claudinite-tasks/docs/tasks-dispatch/`
- `docs/task-preconditions/` → `packs/claudinite-tasks/docs/task-preconditions/`
- `docs/task-code-work/` → `packs/claudinite-tasks/docs/task-code-work/`
- `docs/per-project-scheduling/` → `packs/claudinite-tasks/docs/per-project-scheduling/`

Every file's content is unchanged except for relative links that cross out of the moved tree (`../../packs/…`, `../../engine/…`, `../../routines/…`), which now read two directories deeper (`../../../../…`); links between the four moved docs, and the two historical records' own prose (`MIGRATION.md`, `check-fix-subsumption-audit.md`), are untouched.

## The carve-out: generic, not scoped to claudinite-tasks

`compute-vendor-set.mjs`'s `walk()` now skips a directory named `docs` the same way it already skips `test` and `updates` — **every** pack's own `docs/` is out of the vendor set, not just this one's. `packs/claudinite-dashboard/docs/` is the other instance today, and its own module comments already cite it by `§`-style path in prose rather than resolving it as a mount-time reference (`board.mjs`, `sheet.mjs`, …), so it was already living by this rule before the rule existed — nothing there changes behavior, it just stops vendoring a tree nothing runtime-reads. Pinned with two tests in `compute-vendor-set.test.mjs`: a fixture proving a pack's `docs/` stays out while an operational sibling directory still vendors, and a real-corpus assertion that no canon pack ships its `docs/` while `claudinite-tasks` and `claudinite-dashboard` still ship their operational trees.

If the project's own `CLAUDE.md` names a merge-policy file, that file overrides the divergent
